seo_title: YMCA Singapore Case Study: Content Distribution | SOMIN
description: Fyreflyz used SOMIN to read 416 posts from YMCA of Singapore and six peers: the same story earned 54 engagements on Instagram and 1 on Facebook.
eyebrow: Agency case study · Youth charity · Singapore
h1: YMCA does not have a storytelling problem, it has a distribution problem
lede: Fyreflyz used SOMIN to read 416 posts from YMCA of Singapore and six peers over 90 days. The same story earned 54 engagements on Instagram and 1 on Facebook, and no one ran paid ads.
meta_line: A SOMIN agency pitch · 22 May to 20 Aug 2026 · Singapore

challenge.title: YMCA's 18.8% share of category content earns 18.0% of engagement
challenge.body: SHINE Children & Youth Services posts 77 times to YMCA's 78 yet earns 49% more engagement. The pitch had to find the leak.

approach.title: 80 YMCA posts against 407 from six peers
points: Put YMCA and six peers in one SOMIN workspace.
Audited 50 YMCA posts by channel, format, tone and framing, using medians.
Checked 12 months of paid ads across all seven.
Tracked four monthly trend windows and mapped territory YMCA leaves open.
Built three territories from SOMIN personas, tensions and stories.

findings_title: Where YMCA's engagement leaks: channel, guests and territory

findings.title: Same story, 54x apart
findings.body: It was a vocational-training story. Facebook takes 30% of output for a median of 3, against 19 on Instagram.

findings.title: The best post was a guest's
findings.body: A guest's post on a YMCA event drew the quarter's top 383 engagements. YMCA's own post earned 0.

findings.title: The strongest territory is under-used
findings.body: Impact You Can See returns 27.45 per post against a 19.7 average, on 29 of 80 posts (36%). Inclusion takes 41% but returns least, 17.12.

delivered.title: Three territories, 21 propositions and 54 creatives for YMCA
points: Activations for Impact You Can See, Everyday Good and Champions of Inclusion
40 dated slots in 13 weeks, each tied to a moment trigger
Illustrative paid-funnel tiers of S$30,000, S$60,000 and S$120,000
Creatives across three pillars and funnel stages

quote.text: Nothing about the story was wrong. The distribution was.

outcome.title: YMCA should fix distribution before making more content
outcome.body: The first moves cost nothing: halve Facebook organic posts, add a retargeting pixel and donor-nurture audiences, and brief guests who post about YMCA. Projected engagement per organic post: 19.7 to 26.0 in 13 weeks.

faq.q: What data did the YMCA pitch use?
faq.a: Public posts from YMCA and six peers, 22 May to 20 Aug 2026, and 12 months of paid ads. No audience or donation data.

faq.q: Why cut Facebook instead of adding content?
faq.a: Facebook's median is 3 per post, so the effort moves to Instagram and Facebook carries paid distribution only.
They are projections from category benchmarks and YMCA's baselines. Data starts on 21 Apr 2026.
